PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (16, 10, 22),
    "L_in": (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_ld": (11, 7, 15),
    "L_ld": (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "Itail": (5e-6, 2e-6, 9e-6),
    "I2": (7e-6, 3e-6, 10e-6),
    "L_cs_n": (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),
    "Winv": (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I2 = p["Itail"], p["I2"]

    # Bias mirrors (NMOS, from ibias)
    gmb, Lb = 10, 1.0
    mb = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, It, vds=0.3)
    m6 = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, I2, vds=0.9)

    # Preamp: NMOS differential pair with PMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], It / 2, vds=0.6)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], It / 2, vds=0.8)
    # CS PMOS: same L and gm/Id as the load diode, so it balances when the preamp is balanced
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], I2, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinp > vinn raises o1, which turns M5 off; o2 falls and vout rises.
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # CS stage
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    # Final inverter
    Wn = p["Winv"]
    Wp = 2.5 * Wn
    n.M("MI1", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, 0.15)

    # Performance predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout1 = m1.gds + m3.gds
    A1 = gm1 / gout1
    C1 = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgg + 2 * m5.cgd + 1e-15
    tau1 = C1 / gout1
    t1 = tau1 * math.log(2.0)
    t1 = min(t1, C1 * A1 * vod / max(It / 2, 1e-9))
    Cinv = (Wn + Wp) * 0.15 * 1e-14 + (Wn + Wp) * 0.6e-15
    C2 = m5.cdd + m6.cdd + Cinv + 1e-15
    gout2 = m5.gds + m6.gds
    A2 = m5.gm / gout2
    t2 = C2 * (vdd / 2) / I2 * 0.8
    In_inv = 150e-6 * Wn
    t3 = cl * (vdd / 2) / In_inv
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3

    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2)
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1, "offset": 0.0,
               "gain_db": db(A1 * A2)}
